transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I got kind of wound up with work stuff. I’m usually just one of the crew guys, but I started trying to run three bids at once, calling city people, lining up plant suppliers, messaging basically everyone I knew about this park idea. It felt like I couldn’t really shut it off.
Did you feel anxious about not being able to keep up with all the work you were trying to do?

Yeah… kind of. It was more like my head wouldn’t slow down. I kept thinking about plant lists, park layouts, slogans, who I needed to talk to or impress… I’d write pages in a notebook and still feel like I was behind.
Have you been more physically active than usual lately?
Yeah… I guess so. I was getting up before daylight, loading tools, sketching out beds, pricing native plants. Even after a full day outside, I still felt like I needed to keep going.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I mean… not exactly sure. I’ve been sleeping less, I guess, but I didn’t really think of it as “trouble” sleeping. It’s just been… different.
Did you feel like you could handle all these new responsibilities and projects without any help from others?

Yeah… I thought I could. More than that, I kind of felt like I was about to be the guy every town around here would call for sustainable landscaping. Which sounds… big, I know. I’m still just trying to keep my smaller jobs paid up.
Have you been feeling unusually happy or optimistic lately?

Yeah… before I crashed, I did feel kind of fired up. Like, maybe too optimistic. Almost bigger than myself, I guess.

But it wasn’t all happy. If someone questioned my plan or told me to slow down, I’d snap at them way harder than I should’ve.
Did you often feel irritable or short-tempered during this period of high activity?

Yeah. I guess I was pretty short with people. If a coworker questioned what I was doing or told me to slow down, I’d snap at him… more than made sense. I felt really fired up, and I didn’t take pushback well.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Maybe… about two weeks. It started when I got into remaking myself for that park pitch, and then I kind of crashed after that.
Have your relationships with family or friends been affected by your behavior over the past two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. I was kind of nonstop with people, messaging everybody I knew about this park idea, trying to get them involved or listen to me. Calling city people, suppliers… all of it.

I probably came on too strong. I wasn’t really acting like myself.
How have you been feeling since you said you 'crashed'?

Since then… pretty awful, honestly. I keep thinking I’m just a worthless idiot for putting the business and my name out there like that. Like I got too full of myself, and maybe I deserve to lose everything because of it.
Are you still interested in working on the park idea or has that interest decreased since you crashed?
Yeah… it’s dropped off a lot. Even stuff I usually like, like hiking out by the creeks and taking pictures of trees or the light… I just leave the camera in the truck now. I don’t really care.
Do you feel guilty about how you behaved when you were working on the park idea?
Yeah. I feel… really guilty. I keep thinking I was a worthless idiot for putting my business and my name out there like that. Like I got too full of myself, and now I kind of deserve whatever I lose.
How often have you been thinking you're a worthless idiot since you crashed?
Pretty much all the time. It just keeps coming back… that I’m a worthless idiot for putting my business and my name on the line. Like I got too big for myself and deserve to lose it.
Are you still able to enjoy things you usually liked before you started working on the park idea?

Not really. I mean… I used to clear my head hiking and taking pictures of creek beds and trees, stuff like that. Lately I just leave the camera in the truck. Even if the light’s good, I don’t really care.
Have you been having thoughts of harming yourself since you crashed?

Yeah… I have. I don’t really like saying that.

It got past just wishing I could disappear. I was sitting in my truck after work and… I started thinking about how I could actually do it, with what was there. It scared me.
Have you had any days where you didn't think you were a worthless idiot since you crashed?
Not really. Maybe for a little while if I’m busy, but it comes back. I keep thinking I’m a worthless idiot for putting everything on the line… like I got too full of myself and deserve to lose it.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself since you started feeling like a worthless idiot?

Yeah. Since then it’s been… more than just feeling worthless.

I was in my truck after work and I got scared because I wasn’t only wishing I could disappear. I was thinking about exactly how I could end it with what I had there.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself since you last had thoughts about ending your life in your truck?

Yeah… it’s been like that. Not just wanting to disappear.

After work, sitting in my truck, I caught myself thinking about exactly how I could do it with what was there. That scared me.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling this way?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or anything like that. Just… my own thoughts, I guess.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself today?
Yeah… today too. It’s not just “I don’t want to be here” stuff. I keep thinking about how I could actually do it, like with what’s around me. It scared me.
